title: The Successful farmer of the valley
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：successful　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 successful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the keeper wrote of ① a successful farmer of the valley in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② so successful that nobody in the tower would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the successful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the successful farmer of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too successful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the successful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a successful end of the project, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as successful as the end of the project they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was successful or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something successful, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite successful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the successful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, for the whole place, she wrote of another successful farmer of the valley in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less successful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The successful end of the project that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the successful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 成功（前置定语 a successful farmer of the valley：1988 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件成功的农户）
B. adj. 成功／圆满（两处加强说法：so successful that … 与 no less successful than …）
C. adj. 成功／圆满（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 成功（表语 too successful to do：母亲觉得它太成功，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 圆满（前置定语 a successful end of the project：叔叔把整件事称作一桩圆满的收尾）
F. adj. 圆满（同级比较 as successful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩项目圆满的收尾相比）
G. adj. 圆满（后置定语 something successful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 圆满（受程度副词修饰 quite successful：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a successful farmer of the valley
the successful farmer of the valley that
a successful end of the project
The successful end of the project that

answers.why: successful 意为“成功”，1988 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件成功的农户”，此处作前置定语 a successful farmer of the valley。
successful 意为“成功”，此处用 so successful that 结构，说它成功到钟楼里没人敢靠近。
successful 意为“成功”，年历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的成功山谷里成功的农户，等于最高级的说法。
successful 意为“成功”，母亲认为这件东西“太成功了，谁也用不上”，too successful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
successful 意为“圆满”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩圆满的收尾”，此处作前置定语 a successful end of the project。
successful 意为“圆满”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩项目圆满的收尾一样圆满”，同级比较用 as successful as。
successful 意为“圆满”，年历上那半行字要的是“圆满的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something successful。
successful 意为“圆满”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当圆满”，quite 修饰原级 successful。
successful 意为“圆满”，no less successful than 表示“其圆满不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之圆满不亚于任何人的预料。
successful 意为“圆满”，母亲 2000 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的圆满收尾”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件成功的农户。（a successful farmer of the valley）
它成功到钟楼里没有一个人敢靠近。（so successful that …）
母亲觉得它太成功，谁也用不上。（too successful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩圆满的收尾。（a successful end of the project）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩项目圆满的收尾一样圆满。（as successful as …）
到了 1995 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件圆满的东西。（something successful）
answers: In 1988 the keeper wrote of a successful farmer of the valley in the calendar.
It was so successful that nobody in the tower would go near it.
My mother thought it too successful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a successful end of the project.
He said nobody would call it as successful as the end of the project they had once had.
By 1995 the calendar asked for nothing but something successful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 successful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the keeper wrote of a successful farmer of the valley in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the successful farmer of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too successful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a successful end of the project, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite successful, and everybody laughed.
The successful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
